sentences.text: The documents do not state a gold-loan-specific prepayment/foreclosure charge.

The in-force bank policy says foreclosure charges of 2% plus GST on the principal outstanding shall be levied on all term loans pre-closed by the borrower, foreclosure means pre-payment of the loan in full, and the applicability of pre-payment charges shall be disclosed in the KFS and loan agreement.

missing.searched: searched the in-force bank policy and UCB Responsible Business Conduct Directions, 2025 for gold-loan-specific prepayment/foreclosure charges
